# Ethyca Documentation

> Privacy-as-Code platform documentation. Covers data mapping, consent management, privacy request fulfilment, AI governance assessments, and integrations across 100+ SaaS systems. Authored and maintained by the Ethyca engineering team.

## Overview

- [What is Fides?](https://www.ethyca.com/docs/)
